verses.t: When the earth is shaken with its [final] earthquake
verses.pickthall: When Earth is shaken with her (final) earthquake
verses.yusufAli: When the earth is shaken to her (utmost) convulsion
verses.rodwell: WHEN the Earth with her quaking shall quake
verses.sale: When the earth shall be shaken by an earthquake

verses.t: And the earth discharges its burdens
verses.pickthall: And Earth yieldeth up her burdens
verses.yusufAli: And the earth throws up her burdens (from within)
verses.rodwell: And the Earth shall cast forth her burdens
verses.sale: and the earth shall cast forth her burdens

verses.t: And man says, "What is [wrong] with it
verses.pickthall: And man saith: What aileth her
verses.yusufAli: And man cries (distressed): 'What is the matter with her
verses.rodwell: And man shall say, What aileth her
verses.sale: and a man shall say, what aileth her

verses.t: That Day, it will report its news
verses.pickthall: That day she will relate her chronicles
verses.yusufAli: On that Day will she declare her tidings
verses.rodwell: On that day shall she tell out her tidings
verses.sale: On that day the earth shall declare her tidings

verses.t: Because your Lord has commanded it
verses.yusufAli: For that thy Lord will have given her inspiration
verses.rodwell: Because thy Lord shall have inspired her
verses.sale: for that thy Lord will inspire her

verses.t: That Day, the people will depart separated [into categories] to be shown [the result of] their deeds
verses.pickthall: That day mankind will issue forth in scattered groups to be shown their deeds
verses.yusufAli: On that Day will men proceed in companies sorted out, to be shown the deeds that they (had done)
verses.rodwell: On that day shall men come forward in throngs to behold their works
verses.sale: On that day men shall go forward in distinct classes, that they may behold their works

verses.t: So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it
verses.pickthall: And whoso doeth good an atom's weight will see it then
verses.yusufAli: Then shall anyone who has done an atom's weight of good, see it
verses.rodwell: And whosoever shall have wrought an atom's weight of good shall behold it
verses.sale: And whoever shall have wrought good of the weight of an ant, shall behold the same

verses.t: And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it
verses.pickthall: And whoso doeth ill an atom's weight will see it then
verses.yusufAli: And anyone who has done an atom's weight of evil, shall see it
verses.rodwell: And whosoever shall have wrought an atom's weight of evil shall behold it
verses.sale: And whoever shall have wrought evil of the weight of an ant, shall behold the same
